title: node-postgres ignores the ssl option and fails with 'self-signed certificate in certificate chain' when the URL has sslmode=require
symptoms: Error: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
Adding ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } or a ca next to connectionString changes nothing
cause: pg parses sslmode from the connection string and the result replaces the ssl option you passed instead of merging with it. In pg-connection-string, prefer, require, and verify-ca all mean full certificate verification unless uselibpqcompat=true is set, which differs from libpq.
fix: Drop sslmode from the URL and configure ssl in code, or parse the URL yourself and merge the ssl settings before creating the pool.
affected: pg 8.x with pg-connection-string 2.x, as of October 2026 (merge issue open since 2021)
